input: Explore local farmers markets this Saturday morning

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the user wants to visit one specific market or scout several determines how the morning is structured and how much time to allocate per stop.
The user's city or neighborhood is needed to identify which markets are actually local and reachable on Saturday morning.
Going alone vs. with kids, a partner, or friends changes logistics like transport, pace, and what to prioritise at the market.
A spending budget determines whether this is a browsing trip or a shopping trip, and how much to plan for purchases.
The user may have a specific focus — produce, artisan goods, prepared food, flowers — which shapes which market to prioritise and what to look for.
Knowing what time Saturday morning is available and how the user plans to get there (car, walking, transit) affects which markets are feasible and when to leave.
The user's definition of a successful visit — relaxed browse, filling a weekly grocery list, discovering new vendors — determines how to structure the plan and what to bring.

gold.taskTitle: Explore local farmers markets this Saturday
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to visit one or more nearby farmers markets on Saturday morning, but the specifics around location, purpose, budget, and what success looks like are all undefined.

questions.title: How many markets do you want to visit?

questions.title: Do you have a spending budget in mind?
questions.description: Determines whether this is a casual browse or an intentional shopping trip with planned purchases.

questions.title: What types of goods are you most interested in finding?

questions.title: What time can you head out Saturday morning?
questions.description: Start time and available hours, plus mode of transport, determine which markets are feasible to reach.

questions.title: What would make this visit feel like a success?
questions.description: A relaxed outing, filling a grocery list, or discovering new local vendors — the goal shapes the entire plan.
